## Severity

Pick one: SEV-1 (critical) / SEV-2 (major) / SEV-3 (minor).

## Impact

Who and what is affected? Since when (UTC)?

## Timeline (UTC)

- HH:MM — detected:
- HH:MM — mitigated:
- HH:MM — resolved:

## Response

What was done to contain and fix it? Link related PRs or commits.

## Follow-ups

- [ ] Root cause documented
- [ ] Preventive action filed as an issue
